scope: P02-T01 frozen diff; authenticated loopback preview under a trusted local account
confirmed: New history and restore calls inherit the authenticated API and reject unknown properties, non-UUID IDs, invalid revisions and invalid head fingerprints.
Recovery validates snapshot hashes, project identity and every referenced asset before publishing a replacement head.

Snapshot reads are bounded; content objects enforce hash-only paths, bounded bytes, private POSIX directories and symlink checks; immutable publication does not overwrite existing snapshots or objects.
No new secret exposure, shell interpolation or unauthenticated filesystem endpoint was found.
acceptedLimitations: Same-account mutation after file verification, Windows ACL qualification and Windows power-loss directory durability are explicitly outside this preview guarantee.
Unkeyed integrity receipts detect accidental corruption; they do not authenticate a malicious operator with workspace write access.
Durable jobs, archives and lock recovery remain separate future tasks.

handoff.issue: A head larger than the 2 MiB bound causes history and restore to fail before their damaged-head handling, even when verified snapshots exist.
handoff.fix: Confirm whether oversized damaged heads are included in recovery acceptance; if so, fingerprint and preserve them using a bounded streaming path rather than removing the read cap.

validation: Static review of the frozen diff and relevant storage, path, schema, media and authenticated HTTP context; frozen diff SHA-256 verified. Parent-provided test and E2E results were not independently rerun.
